visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight macro close-up of a spoonful of glistening, oily beef intestines dripping with creamy soup, held against a warm-toned indoor restaurant background. Large white captions are overlaid at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) A person's hand is seen placing a large stainless steel pot onto a black induction cooktop. The pot is meticulously arranged with a center row of green chives topped with red chili flakes and sesame seeds, surrounded by mounds of white cabbage and pale beef intestines in a simmering yellow broth. (3) The camera pans across various side dishes including a bowl of seasoned tripe and a plate of red meat. A hand uses wooden chopsticks to lift pieces of beef intestine and chives from the pot. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the textures of the food. (4) A medium shot shows a highball glass filled with a lemon drink and ice, featuring a QR code label on the glass. A split-screen montage then appears, listing the components of a 'Yamakasa Set' including hotpot, salad, and horse meat sashimi. (5) Close-ups follow showing a piece of bright red raw horse meat being dipped into a small dish of dark soy sauce with chopsticks. Another shot shows a large, textured piece of bright orange-pink mentaiko (spicy cod roe) being handled with chopsticks. (6) The mentaiko is placed into the boiling hotpot. Then, thick yellow ramen-style noodles are lifted high from the steaming, bubbly broth. (7) The final shot pans across the interior of the restaurant located within a brightly lit shopping mall, showing wooden partitions, glowing orange lights, and several customers seated at tables with their backs to the camera.
